requirements.title: End-User Self-Service UI for Profile, MFA, Sessions, and Connected Accounts
requirements.description: Authenticated users must have a self-service portal to: update display name and email (with re-verification); change password; enroll and remove MFA methods (TOTP, passkeys); view and revoke their own active sessions (with device/IP metadata); view and unlink connected social accounts; and download or delete their account data. All destructive actions require confirmation.

validation.notes: api/handlers/user/self_service_e2e_test.go: user calls password-change RPC with correct current password → 200; old password no longer works; new password works
api/handlers/session/self_service_session_e2e_test.go: user lists their own sessions and revokes one; the revoked session's token is subsequently rejected
bas/user/profile_update_test: user changes display name and verifies the change persists after page reload
bas/user/session_revoke_test: user views active sessions list, identifies a session by IP/device, revokes it, and confirms it disappears from the list
bas/user/mfa_management_test: user enrolls TOTP, verifies it is listed under security methods, then removes it and confirms MFA is no longer required at next sign-in
